Address to area lookup procedure and area allocation or teardown
Contents of region operations and area operations method tables

findings.text: Reference counting service fused with a spin lock offers unconditional acquire, conditional acquire gated on positive or non negative count, release reporting survivors, release that retains the lock at the final reference, and transition to a dead marker. Each path first attempts an atomic update and otherwise uses the embedded lock.

Logical IO memory service offers region registration plus sized read, sized write, fill and block copy operations. Registration validates inputs and resource type, reserves the resource, then links the node. Accessors resolve an address to an area slot and call that area methods, using warning fallbacks when unmapped.

Top level locking self test checks global debug state, enables a recursive read mode for part of the run, executes deadlock, interrupt safety, wait context, local lock and naming suites, then classifies totals into unexpected failures versus expected failures versus full success and restores global state.

Nesting permission is defined by outer context crossed with inner primitive. Hard interrupt, soft interrupt, read side, bottom half read side and spin outers permit read side, raw spin and spin but forbid mutex. Non threaded hard interrupt, scheduler read side and raw spin outers permit only read side and raw spin. Mutex outer permits all four inner kinds.

Optimistic update reads the combined word once, requires an eight byte width, proceeds only while the observed lock looks free, mutates a copy through caller supplied logic, attempts a relaxed wide compare exchange, retries on contention up to a fixed bound then exits to the locked path. An alternate build disables the loop so the locked path is always used.

Conditional acquire succeeds only when the observed count satisfies its gate and otherwise reports failure without mutating. Release decrements and reports survivors, with one variant returning a negative sentinel on empty input and another variant stopping early to let the caller hold the lock at the final reference. Dead marking stores a negative sentinel.

Logical addresses embed an area selector in high bits and an offset in low bits. Accessors isolate the offset before calling area methods. Two build variants use different bias and mask pairs to recognize the logical range. Addresses without a mapped area use dedicated warning handlers.
Block fill and block copy prefer a bulk area method when the area provides one and otherwise loop one byte at a time through single byte area methods, preserving start offset plus index addressing.

Changing the dependency subclass of a semaphore preserves its reported dependency name. Name lookup returns the stored name when tracking is enabled and a null pointer otherwise, and the test asserts equality across the subclass change.
One compilation unit defines a default log prefix for diagnostics and a dedicated mutex object for IO range work, though this lane shows no acquisition sites for the latter.
A global mutex protects the shared region list during registration. It is acquired after successful resource reservation and released after the new node is linked, covering only list mutation.

Each reference object carries its own spin lock guarding slow path count updates. Dead marking requires that lock to be held on entry. The fast path avoids acquiring it while the observed state looks unlocked.
Test scopes use guard objects for interrupt, soft interrupt and read side contexts, nesting an outer guard with an inner guard so release occurs in reverse order with the inner scope ending first.
Region node contains a pointer to a resource description, a pointer to region operations, and linkage for a doubly linked list.
Area slot contains a pointer to area operations and an opaque private pointer. A global table holds one such slot per addressable area.
Lock and count share one atomically updatable eight byte unit, allowing a single wide compare exchange to validate the lock state and update the count together.

Count lifecycle moves from non negative live values through increments and decrements to a negative dead marker written under lock. Once dead, conditional acquires fail while unconditional paths are no longer used for that object.

Outer contexts belong to three preemption classes. Fully preemptible expects all inner kinds to succeed. Limited preemption expects read side, raw spin and spin to succeed with mutex to fail. Non preemptible expects only read side and raw spin to succeed with spin and mutex to fail.

Self test outcome handling distinguishes disabled input, unexpected failures which disable debugging, partially expected failures, fully expected failures, and full success. All terminal paths restore the dedicated task pointer and clear the silent flag.
Access to an unmapped logical address triggers a warning. Sized reads return all bits set, block reads fill the destination with all bits set, and writes or fills have no effect beyond the warning.

Optimistic retry is bounded and abandons the fast path under persistent contention or when the lock looks held. Slow paths revalidate the count under lock before mutating, avoiding increment from empty or decrement below the final reference without holding the lock.

Local lock inversion checks treat two early cycles as false positives that must pass because local scopes are ignored, while a later variant that adds a genuine spin to spin cycle under disabled interrupts must be reported as a failure.

Mixed safety chains are distinguished by interrupt class. A soft unsafe to soft safe step is not a deadlock, while a hard safe to hard unsafe progression across a longer chain is reported as a deadlock.
Area shift equals 24, so each area spans sixteen megabytes and offsets occupy the low 24 bits.
Area table sizing allows 128 areas within a 31 bit space. Selector bits are the high bits above the shift and the mask isolates the offset.
One build recognizes logical addresses with bias DEAD000000000000 hex and mask FFFFFFFF00000000 hex. The other build uses bias 80000000 hex with mask 80000000 hex.
